subject: D-INTEG-01 physical FEM media contract
body:
TASK: D-INTEG-01 / D-06
STATUS: CANDIDATE (not FEM_PERSIST_PASS, not M2_PASS)
PROGRAM=NO. XSim != board. OOC != integrated.

FEM_STORAGE: canonical T2 DDR via MIG (Arty A7-100T). T1 BRAM is hot cache only. C fem_lifecycle 32-bit sync T2 is a local model, not the persistence contract.
MIG_APP_DATA_WIDTH: still UNKNOWN (no generated MIG). Packing hypothesis APP_W=128.

WRITE_ATOMICITY: MIG UI beat (hypothesis 128b) + DDR BL8. 32-bit FEM words can tear inside a beat/RMW/reset.
COMPLETION_AUTHORITY: dest readback of targeted lane == payload AND rsp txn_id/generation match AND wr_outstanding cleared by that matching rsp. FIFO-empty is not complete (PROXY_METRIC_FALSE_PASS_GUARD).
RESET: outstanding writes are not drained; dest may be old/new/mixed. Recovery must dest-reread.

INTEGRITY: CRC16-CCITT-FALSE over dest W0||W1. ECC UNKNOWN until MIG exists. CRC generated before CRCW dest write; checked after dest reread. Recovery always rereads COMMIT, CRCW, W0, W1 from dest.
COMMITTED_CORRUPT: dest COMMIT magic AND dest CRC invalid. This is FEM_DEST_INTEGRITY, NOT recover_state=3, NOT a fourth compaction state.
fem_commit_class: dest_committed_corrupt=1; recover_state stays OLD_VALID (0). INDEX must not upgrade to COMMITTED_NEW. No roll-forward index/retire.

C NEED: fem_lifecycle still pulses t2_we and advances the next word the next cycle. D added fem_t2_adapter (t2_ready/t2_ack). Please wait on t2_ack (or equivalent dest-complete) after every T2 write/read before advancing B0..B6. Do not treat rec_committed as magic-only: COMMIT+CRC-fail must not take R_FIXIDX/R_RET.

XSim: FEM_MEDIA_XSIM_PASS @357ns; FEM_T2_ADAPTER_XSIM_PASS @555ns. Not FEM_PERSIST_PASS.
